title: Magic Farm
description: A media team lands in the wrong country while pursuing a musician's story. They team up with locals to create viral content, forming bonds as a health crisis emerges in the background.

title: Scream 7
description: Ghostface returns with a vengeance - and this time it's personal. Sidney Prescott has built a quiet life with her family, far from the horrors that once defined her. But when Sidney's daughter becomes his next target, her worst fears become reality. Forced to face the nightmare she thought was buried, Sidney launches a relentless fight to protect her family.

title: Power Ballad
description: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick's songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves -- even if it means risking everything he cares about.

title: All Night Wrong
description: Gary and Ell meet for a blind date only to accidentally wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

title: Special Delivery
description: Ralph's life starts going downhill when he doesn't clear the snow from the front sidewalk.

title: Murder She Baked: A Deadly Recipe
description: Bakery owner Hannah Swensen just can't keep her hands out of the batter when murder stirs things up in Lake Eden, Minn.

title: Murder, She Baked: Just Desserts
description: Hannah Swensen is chosen as a guest for the first Eden Lake Dessert Bake-Off, but when fellow judge, coach Boyd Watson is found murdered, Hannah takes it upon herself to find out who killed Boyd Watson.

title: The Grizzlie Truth
description: Superfan filmmaker Kat Jayme investigates the abrupt move of her NBA hometown team, the Vancouver Grizzlies, to Memphis in 2001. Much more than a sore spot, it's an unsolved mystery and possibly a criminal conspiracy. The investigation becomes a love letter to the worst professional sports franchise in history and an exploration into the deep roots of fandom.

title: Merry Pickleball Match
description: Tennis star Luke Hollis heads home for Christmas and discovers his family's racquet club is about to be sold.

title: Spider-Man
description: "Spider-Man" centers on student Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) who, after being bitten by a genetically-altered spider, gains superhuman strength and the spider-like ability to cling to any surface. He vows to use his abilities to fight crime, coming to understand the words of his beloved Uncle Ben: "With great power comes great responsibility.".

title: Spider-Man 2
description: When a failed nuclear fusion experiment results in an explosion that kills his wife, Dr. Otto Octavius is transformed into Dr. Octopus, a cyborg with deadly metal tentacles. Doc Ock blames Spider-Man for the accident and seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Spidey's alter ego, Peter Parker, faces fading powers and self-doubt. Complicating matters are his best friend's hatred for Spider-Man and his true love's sudden engagement to another man.

title: Spider-Man 3
description: Peter Parker and M.J. seem to finally be on the right track in their complicated relationship, but trouble looms for the superhero and his lover. Peter's Spider-Man suit turns black and takes control of him, not only giving Peter enhanced power but also bringing out the dark side of his personality. He must overcome the suit's influence as two supervillains, Sandman and Venom, rise up to destroy him and all those he holds dear.

title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
description: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

title: The Family McMullen
description: A close-knit family navigates life's ups and downs, confronting personal struggles and evolving bonds. As they face unexpected hurdles, their connections are tested, revealing the complexities of love, loyalty and growth within a family.

title: The Hand That Rocks the Cradle
description: A suspenseful and seductive psychological thriller that reimagines the film and unravels the illusion of domestic bliss with chilling precision. In the psychological thriller from director Michelle Garza Cervera, an upscale suburban mom (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) brings a new nanny (Maika Monroe) into her home, only to discover she is not the person she claims to be.

title: The Breadwinner
description: A man becomes a stay-at-home dad when a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity takes his wife on a prolonged business trip for one month. With three young daughters and little experience handling their day-to-day needs, he soon realizes that running a household is the toughest gig he's ever had.

title: The End of Oak Street
description: A mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports a neighborhood to someplace unknown. The Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

title: The Choral
description: As World War I rages on, Dr. Henry Guthrie takes over a British choral society that's lost most of its men to the army. The community soon discovers that the best response to the chaos of war is to make beautiful music together.

title: The Christmas Clues
description: Piper, a big-city writer, thinks she left her hometown and first love, Dawson, behind. But when they're both invited home for the holidays to compete for their late mentor's estate, they unravel clues and challenges with other former students.

title: Secret Headquarters
description: Friendship and courage take center stage when Charlie and his friends stumble upon the headquarters of the Guard and realize the world's most powerful superhero is Charlie's dad. When an evil businessman sends in a team to infiltrate the lair and retrieve the Guard's energy source, the youngsters spring into action and turn the tables on the intruders.

title: Love: The Last Chapter
description: Six people find romance while living in a senior facility.

title: Charlie the Wonderdog
description: A dog gains superpowers after his owner is abducted by aliens. Together they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

title: Elli and Her Monster Team
description: A homeless ghost seeking belonging at a Ghost Train draws unwanted outside attention, forcing her and its monster residents to embark on a quest to save their home and her chance at finding family.

title: Fall Into Winter
description: Life quickly changes for Kerry as she has to work alongside her high school nemesis, Brooks, an old friend of her brother's who unexpectedly buys into Kerry's family-owned candy shop.

title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
description: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally loony.
